lemmas.primary_translation: great efforts without useful results / much fuss without much reason

definitions.translation: great efforts without useful results (lit. much screaming and little wool)

examples.no: på dugnaden var det mye skrik og lite ull, så de måtte gjøre alt arbeidet om igjen noen uker senere
examples.en: at the volunteer workday, there was a lot of effort and little to show for it, so they had to redo all the work a few weeks later

examples.no: ryktene om at filmskuespilleren kom til bygda var mye skrik og lite ull
examples.en: the rumors that the film actor came to the village were much ado about nothing
